column1: saturate§Four days of rain saturated the ground so completely that the next storm ran straight off into the town.§四天的雨把地面**浸透**得如此彻底，下一场暴雨直接漫进了小镇。§satur（充满，同 satisfy 满足）
savanna§The savanna supports nine grazing species that never compete, because each eats a different height of grass.§这片**热带草原**养活着九种从不竞争的食草动物，因为它们各吃不同高度的草。§
scandalous§The scandalous detail was true and irrelevant, and it displaced four days of coverage of the actual finding.§那个**耸人听闻的**细节属实却无关，它挤掉了四天对真正发现的报道。§
scapegoat§The junior officer became the scapegoat, and the four people who set the policy were promoted.§这名下级军官成了**替罪羊**，而制定政策的那四个人升了职。§ 出自圣经中背负罪孽被放逐的山羊
scathing§Her scathing review ended a friendship and, four years later, was quoted approvingly by its target.§她那篇**尖刻的**评论断送了一段友谊，四年后却被批评对象赞许地引用。§
scent§The dogs picked up the scent nine hours after the search began and found him within forty minutes.§搜索开始九小时后犬只捕捉到**气味**，四十分钟内找到了他。§
scholarly§The scholarly edition has four hundred pages of notes and is the only one the family authorized.§这个**学术**版本有四百页注释，也是家属唯一授权的版本。§
scoff§Colleagues scoffed at the method for nine years and now teach it in the introductory course.§同行**嗤笑**这套方法九年，如今在入门课上教它。§
scope§The scope of the review was narrowed four times, and the final version examined about a ninth of the original question.§这次评审的**范围**被缩窄了四次，最终版只审查了原问题的约九分之一。§
scorn§Her scorn for the process did not stop her following it exactly, which is why her objection stood.§她对这套流程的**蔑视**并未妨碍她一丝不苟地遵守，所以她的异议站住了。§
scour§They scoured four archives in three countries and found the letter in a box marked "miscellaneous."§他们**搜遍**三个国家的四座档案馆，最后在标着「杂项」的箱子里找到了那封信。§
scrupulous§Her scrupulous accounting is the reason the charity survived an investigation that closed nine others.§她**一丝不苟的**记账，是这家慈善机构挺过一场关停了另外九家的调查的原因。§scrup（尖石）→ 鞋里有石子，硌得不敢马虎
scrutinize§Nobody scrutinized the invoices for four years, and the ninth auditor found the pattern in a morning.§四年无人**细查**这些发票，而第九位审计员一个上午就看出了规律。§
scrutiny§The proposal collapsed under scrutiny: four of its nine assumptions could not be sourced at all.§这项提案在**审视**下垮掉——它九个假设中的四个完全找不到出处。§
scuttle§The captain scuttled the ship rather than surrender it, and the wreck was found ninety years later.§船长宁可**凿沉**船也不交出它，残骸九十年后被发现。§
seclude§She secluded herself for nine months to finish the book and answered exactly four letters.§她**隐居**九个月完成这本书，只回了四封信。§se（分开）+ clud（关闭，同 include 包括）
seclusion§The seclusion of the valley preserved a dialect that has now four hundred speakers left.§这条河谷的**与世隔绝**保存了一种如今只剩四百人会说的方言。§
secrecy§The secrecy served nobody: the four facts it protected were published by a rival within a month.§这种**保密**对谁都没好处——它保护的四个事实一个月内就被对手公布了。§secr（分开，同 secret 秘密）
secretive§He was secretive about the method and generous with the results, which four collaborators found maddening.§他对方法**讳莫如深**，对结果却慷慨，四位合作者为此抓狂。§
sedate§The sedate atmosphere of the reading room ended when the fire alarm went off at four.§阅览室**安静沉稳的**气氛，在四点火警响起时结束了。§sed（坐，同 sedentary 久坐的）
sedentary§The job is sedentary for nine hours a day, and the company's insurer noticed before the company did.§这份工作每天有九小时是**久坐的**，公司的保险公司比公司自己先注意到。§sed（坐，同 reside 居住）
seditious§The pamphlet was ruled seditious in 1794 and is now sold in the museum's gift shop.§这本小册子 1794 年被判为**煽动性的**，如今在博物馆礼品店出售。§se（分开）+ it（走，同 exit 出去）→ 拉着人分道走
sedulous§Her sedulous checking of every reference delayed the book by four months and saved its reputation.§她对每一条参考文献的**勤勉**核对把书拖了四个月，也保住了它的声誉。§se（分开）+ dul ← dol（欺骗）→ 不耍滑
seep§Water seeped through the roof for nine years before anyone connected it to the crack in the wall.§水从屋顶**渗漏**了九年，才有人把它与墙上的裂缝联系起来。§
self-centered§The most self-centered person in the meeting asked the only question about anyone else's workload.§会上最**自我中心的**那个人，问了唯一一个关于别人工作量的问题。§
self-critical§She is self-critical to a fault, and four colleagues have told her the same thing in the same words.§她**自我批评**到过头，四位同事用同样的话对她说过同一件事。§
self-destructive§The self-destructive decision was taken in about nine minutes and took four years to undo.§这个**自毁的**决定约在九分钟内做出，花了四年才收拾干净。§
self-evaluation§The self-evaluation form runs to nine pages and is read, on the evidence, by nobody at all.§这份**自评**表长达九页，而从证据看根本没有人读。§
selfishness§What looked like selfishness was exhaustion, and the four people who knew that said nothing.§看着像**自私**的其实是精疲力竭，而知道这一点的四个人什么也没说。§
self-serving§The account he gave the inquiry is self-serving throughout and, in four checkable particulars, entirely accurate.§他向调查组提供的说法通篇**自利**，而在四个可核查的细节上完全准确。§
sensation§The sensation lasted four days, and the paper behind it has been cited nine times since.§这阵**轰动**持续四天，而它背后的论文此后被引用九次。§sens（感觉，同 sense 感觉）
sensational§The sensational headline had almost nothing to do with the nine hundred words beneath it.§这个**耸人听闻的**标题与它下面的九百字几乎毫无关系。§
sensationalism§Sensationalism sold four hundred thousand copies and cost the paper the source it most needed.§**煽情主义**卖了四十万份，也让报纸失去了它最需要的消息来源。§
sensible§The sensible course was obvious to everyone except the four people empowered to choose it.§**明智的**做法对所有人都显而易见，除了有权选择它的那四个人。§
sentimental§The sentimental ending was tested on four audiences and kept, against the director's wishes.§这个**煽情的**结尾在四组观众身上试过，最终违背导演意愿保留了下来。§
sequence§The sequence matters: doing step four before step three produces a result that looks correct and is not.§**顺序**很要紧——把第四步放在第三步前，得出的结果看着对，其实不对。§sequ（跟随，同 consequence 后果）
serendipity§The discovery was pure serendipity: they were looking for a fault and found a nine-thousand-year-old floor.§这项发现纯属**机缘巧合**——他们在找断层，却找到一层九千年前的地面。§ 源自童话《锡兰三王子》，主角总在意外中有所得
serene§She looked serene through nine hours of questioning that her lawyer later described as brutal.§在律师后来形容为残酷的九小时讯问中，她始终显得**平静安详**。§seren（晴朗）
serenity§The serenity of the site is entirely modern: four hundred people worked here, loudly, until 1962.§这处遗址的**宁静**完全是现代产物——1962 年前有四百人在这里喧闹地劳作。§
sermonize§He sermonized for forty minutes about punctuality and arrived, the following week, nine minutes late.§他就守时**说教**了四十分钟，下一周自己迟到了九分钟。§sermon（布道）
serpentine§The serpentine queue filled four corridors, and the office it led to was open for ninety minutes.§这条**蜿蜒曲折的**队伍填满四条走廊，而它通向的办公室只开九十分钟。§serpent（蛇）
servile§His servile manner with donors was matched by a coldness to staff that four people reported.§他对捐赠者**卑躬屈膝的**做派，与对员工的冷淡形成对照，有四人反映过这点。§serv（奴隶，同 servant 仆人）
servility§The servility of the report is its weakness: it accepts nine claims that a phone call would have checked.§这份报告的**奴颜**是它的弱点——它接受了九个打个电话就能核实的说法。§
setback§The setback cost four months and, in the end, produced a better design than the original plan.§这次**挫折**耗掉四个月，最终却产出了比原方案更好的设计。§set（放）+ back（后）
severe§The shortage was severe for nine weeks and, in four districts, has never fully ended.§这次短缺**严重**了九周，而在四个区从未完全结束。§sever（严格）
shopworn§The argument is shopworn and still correct, which is an awkward combination for a reviewer.§这个论点**陈旧老套**却仍然正确，这对评论者是个尴尬的组合。§shop（店铺）+ worn（磨旧）→ 摆久了的货
showy§The showy entrance hall consumed nine percent of the entire budget and provides seating for nobody at all.§这个**华而不实的**门厅吞掉了整个预算的百分之九，却一个座位也没有。§
shrewd§A shrewd guess about the timing was worth more than four months of formal analysis.§一次对时机**精明的**猜测，比四个月的正式分析更有价值。§
shroud§Secrecy shrouded the project for nine years, and the first public document was a demolition notice.§保密**笼罩**了这个项目九年，第一份公开文件是一张拆除通知。§
shyness§Her shyness was read as arrogance for four years, which cost her more than either would have alone.§她的**害羞**被误读为傲慢达四年之久，其代价超过两者单独造成的。§
significant§The difference is significant statistically and trivial practically, and only one of those made the headline.§这个差异在统计上**显著**，在实践中微不足道，而上标题的只有其中一样。§sign（记号）+ fic（做）
similarity§The similarity between the two texts runs to nine consecutive sentences, which is difficult to explain innocently.§这两份文本的**相似**延续了九个连续句子，很难做无辜的解释。§simil（相似，同 similar 相似的）
simplicity§The simplicity of the design is its whole achievement: four parts, one moving, no adjustment ever needed.§这个设计的**简洁**就是它的全部成就——四个零件、一个活动件，永不需调整。§simpl（单一，同 simple 简单的）
simplification§The simplification removed nine exceptions from the rule, and four of them turned out to matter enormously.§这次**简化**从规则里去掉了九项例外，其中四项后来证明极其重要。§
simplistic§The account is simplistic rather than simple, and the difference is about four missing causes.§这份记述是**过分简单化的**而非简洁的，差别在于约四个被略去的原因。§
sincerity§Her sincerity was never in doubt, and it made the four factual errors much harder to correct.§她的**真诚**从无人怀疑，而这让那四处事实错误更难纠正。§sincer（纯净）
singularly§The building is singularly ugly and singularly well suited to what happens inside it.§这栋楼**格外**丑陋，也格外适合里面发生的事。§singul（单个，同 single 单个的）
situate§The plant was situated four miles upwind of the town, which nobody thought about until 1994.§这座工厂**坐落**在小镇上风向四英里处，这一点直到 1994 年才有人想到。§situ（位置，同 situation 情况）
skeptic§The one skeptic on the panel asked for the raw data and was, nine months later, proved right.§评审组里唯一的**怀疑者**索要了原始数据，九个月后被证明是对的。§
skepticism§Healthy skepticism cost the field four years and saved it from a much longer detour.§健康的**怀疑**让这个领域损失四年，也救它免于一段长得多的弯路。§
slapstick§The slapstick in the first act misleads the audience about a play that turns very dark by the fourth.§第一幕的**闹剧**让观众误判了这部戏，而到第四幕它变得非常晦暗。§slap（拍打）+ stick（棍）→ 打人作响的道具棍
slender§The evidence is slender and the conclusion is confident, which four reviewers pointed out separately.§证据**单薄**而结论笃定，四位评审分别指出了这一点。§
slipshod§The slipshod paperwork cost them the appeal, and the underlying case was almost certainly sound.§**马虎潦草的**文书让他们输掉上诉，而案子本身几乎肯定站得住。§slip（滑）+ shod（穿鞋的）→ 鞋都没穿好
slovenly§His slovenly notes were unreadable to everyone but himself, which nine collaborators discovered too late.§他**邋遢潦草的**笔记除了他自己谁也读不懂，九位合作者发现得太晚。§
smug§The smug tone of the announcement annoyed people who would otherwise have welcomed the news.§这则公告**自鸣得意的**语气惹恼了本会欢迎这条消息的人。§
sneer§A single sneer in the margin of the manuscript tells you more about the reader than four pages of notes.§手稿边上一句**讥笑**，比四页笔记更能说明这位读者是什么人。§
